articles.summary: Clearance would position the Ceribell System as the first and only point-of-care electroencephalography (EEG) technology to aid in detection and monitoring of Large Vessel Occlusion (LVO) stroke in the hospital setting SUNNYVALE, Calif., Jan. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- CeriBell, Inc.
articles.title: Ceribell Receives FDA Breakthrough Device Designation for LVO Stroke Detection and Monitoring Solution
